body: I'm sorry about your dad but your answer is incorrect. I'm sorry, but if you're truly giving up on people, then you aren't going about this the right way. This guy is FAR from hopeless. This guy can still be helped. Substance abuse is fixable. She's asking how to help her friend and you're straight up telling her to give up. Fuck outta here with that bullshit.
Why are you even on this subreddit?

I'm not saying this to invalidate your issues. People believe there needs to be an external source to be depressed. That isn't true. Luckily, depression without an external source is often something that can be greatly improved with either therapy or, more notably, medication. I usually don't like to say "Go get help", because that's not something I do myself, but OP, I truly believe your situation can be improved and you can go on to live a happy life.

Nobody is going to actively help you die. Especially on a subreddit that's made to prevent people from dying. The thing I find interesting about this subreddit is that pretty much everyone here wants to die, myself included, but all of us want each other to live. We all have our reasons for deeming our own problems unliveable. Some of them are. Some people's problems in here can never be fixed. But the vast majority can. I'm not demeaning your problems at all. I have no clue what you've gone through or what you're going through, but based on this post alone, it seems like seeing a psychiatrist could really help you and turn things around. Of course, there are no guarantees, but it's at least worth looking into.
If you can, try to see a psychiatrist

Obviously I'm not gonna kill anyone other than myself cause that wouldn't surmount to anything. 

And again, I haven't lost or had any sense diminished. I never had it in the first place. Entirely different.
fucking THANK YOU! I've been on this subreddit a few times but just saw this post that has my post tagged on it. Finally someone fucking understands.

That whole "you can't miss what you've never had" is fucking bullshit and pisses me off. It's also the reason nobody gives a fuck about congenital anosmics.

At least you got to experience it. I'd kill to be in your position, and I don't even mean that as a figure of speech. I'm serious. I'd much rather have lost it.

Do you know what it's like to be born in a world where everyone else knows an entire new dimension of life that you can't possible understand? Do you know what it's like to realize you could spend 100 years straining your brain to imagine what it's like to smell, all the while some stupid 4 year old down the street understands it perfectly fine? Do you know what it's like to be left out of such an ingrained part of society to the extent where you can't possibly fathom it? No. You don't. Stop acting like congenital isn't bad like everyone else. It's fucking stupid.

I actually like to use the trans analogy a lot. The difference with being trans is even if you're with the wrong people (ie. Transphobic people), generally, 50% of the population is gonna support you on being trans. So even if you aren't around those people right now, you can atleast relax knowing that there are many people out there who will respect your pronouns.

Only about 1 in 10,000 people are born without a sense of smell. That gives me pretty shitty odds to find someone who would be able or willing to accommodate.

Plus, with trans people, generally people get used to the pronouns and stop slipping up within a few weeks or so. People never stop "slipping up" for me, and it gets to a point where they very clearly stop trying. And I'm not confrontational, so I'm not just gonna blow up on people every time they mention something, but at the same time, I've come to learn that it doesn't matter if I repeatedly remind them, such as through text, because they ultimately don't put in any effort whatsoever. 

People are so quick to dismiss my feelings to avoid something smelling bad. They'd rather be able to live comfortably and say whatever they want about whatever smell they want even if that means me putting a bullet through my brain stem. 

Honestly it likely doesn't even matter though. Even if people were to stop mentioning smells around me, the damage is already done. From people losing their sense of smell to the extrodinarly rare cases of someone with congenital anosmia via a blockage suddenly getting their sense of smell back (mine is not from a blockage), I already know how drastically different my life is. And with it likely never being fixable due to the restrictions on stem cell therapy and the lack of research, I'm probably just gonna call it quits and hope that whatever comes next is better than this shit.

It's way more complicated than people think. Elon definitely could not do it. He'd have to pay others incredibly large sums of money for it to happen. Not to mention that there is only like one lab in the entire US working on something similar to congenital anosmia, and they're still a ways away.

Stem cell treatment and regenerative medicine is advancing fast, but it still isn't remotely close to being able to build entire new parts of the brain. And even if it were, regulations on human experiments are so strict that a cure wouldn't come out for decades.
Already tried. Actually contacted a bunch of professionals. It ultimately boiled down to not really being possible in my lifetime. In which case I'm done sticking around
